fidelity.method: token-level SequenceMatcher plus order-insensitive coverage and recall; gold markup stripped, case/diacritic/punctuation normalised, CJK compared per character
fidelity.caveat: Cannot detect invention, and a low volume ratio is not evidence of loss. Read the gold set's CROSSCHECK_REPORT.md before acting on any number, noting that it puts the transcription on trial rather than the extractor: same arithmetic, different subject, so several of its false positives are findings here.

figure_detection.method: per-page counts of gold [FIGURE]/[PLATE] blocks against physical figures.json detections; image-sharing logical plate children are excluded, typed panel siblings collapse to one figure, and matched = min(gold, found) per page
figure_detection.caveat: A page-level count cannot tell a page that found the right two figures from one that found two wrong ones. The gold set records no bounding boxes, so nothing finer is available.

caption_binding.method: figure numbers parsed independently from labels printed inside a gold [FIGURE]/[PLATE] block, including controlled plate inventories and standalone engraved-number lines; an immediately adjacent plate heading is included as plate identity evidence. Compared per page against typed figures.json identities (plate:N is distinct from figure:N); caption text is scored only within number-matched pairs
caption_binding.caveat: Naive caption-text similarity reports 44% and is mostly artifact — bilingual captions, bare labels, and documents that are their own translation. Numbers are the language-independent signal. Reported-pair capacity is the maximum same-page typed-identity recall possible if the current number of distinct reported identities on each page is held fixed; it diagnoses missing evidence, not a ceiling on a rebuild that discovers more labels.
